entries.prompt: Edit this existing square 2-by-2 game sprite atlas for LUMINAe. Preserve true transparent background, 2x2 cell grid, cell order, separated self-contained isometric cutouts, cool blue/silver architecture, detailed premium science-fiction rendering and generous fully transparent gutters. Update the four technologies to physically legible complete infrastructure. Upper-left: Starway Spine is an immense curved beam-launch array with two tiny sailcraft and service docks; remove every portal and glowing wormhole, the focused propulsion beam touches the sails instead. Upper-right: Recursive Commonwealth is an inhabited tiered civic-service complex with varied but connected architectural districts and courier docks, no globe models or floating planets. Lower-left: Extinction Archive is a protected tall archive vault with receiver dishes, repository galleries, and small departing record couriers, no miniature suns or globe models. Lower-right: Chronology Accord is an open three-arm timing observatory with separate receiver platforms and fine calibrated laser links, not a magical clock or radiant pillar. Everything stays fully within its own quadrant with at least 6% transparent cell padding. Same consistent viewing angle. No ground square, no background, no painted space/stars, no cast shadow outside the cutout, no text, no labels, no UI frame. Each sprite must depict a functioning achievement, never a token.
entries.review: Four distinct physical infrastructure cutouts on true transparency. Portal, black-hole, and spatial-rift depictions replaced to match practical capabilities.
